title: World Bloom — With You at SEKAI's Beginnings — Episode9 All for Them!

meta.Event Outline: From their space between worlds, Miku and the others watch over everyone. Just then, a fragment appears before them. It takes them to see everyone at the moment their true feelings were born.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey...
This looks like a fun SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: There's even a bunch of stuff drawn on the walls everywhere...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Pretty sure it's called “graffiti” or something.
That's really cool!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (I knew it! That's me, but this SEKAI's version!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? That flyer over there...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: RAD WEEKEND...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...! This must be what the owners of these feelings want to...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right. This is that legendary event...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I have no idea what it was like, but it seems pretty amazing...!
Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (It's Rin...!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, have you already checked everything out around here?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Isn't this place so exciting?!
It's like there's music everywhere!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you think it all has to do with this event? With RAD WEEKEND?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it's gotta!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The owners of these feelings... Akito and the others are probably all singing and practicing really hard in order to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, Rin!
Why don't we also practice?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Imagine everyone coming over with questions about singing but we aren't able to help them. That'd be kind of a problem, right?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wanna become a way better singer, so I'll be able to help them when that happens!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That means we gotta make sure we're as good as they are!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, ready?!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: ーー♪ ーー♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You sound really good, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You too, Rin!
Next, let's kick it up a notch!!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: ーー♪ ーー~~~~♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow, we harmonized so well just now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, we did! There's definitely nothing wrong with our teamwork! We should be able to help everyone whenever they need us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I guess these two were also good partners since day one...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Which explains why they've been able to help Akito and the others so much.)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (And I'm sure these two will keep doing a great job with them moving forward!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: My throat's starting to feel really parched after all that singing...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I know...!
Wanna check out that cafe?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? There's a cafe?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I just saw Miku and MEIKO getting everything ready inside!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They might be all finished now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, where did MEIKO go? We originally ended up in this SEKAI together...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Maybe I'll find her at the cafe.
I've gotta follow them!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're running this cafe, MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you already heard?
I was just in the middle of mixing up some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I knew I'd find you here, MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Len, did you come here with them?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yup!
Guess what? I got to see the moment when Akito and Toya first met.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
They were so cool!
Even back then, they took singing really seriously as they pursued their dream together...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see.
I got to see An...and not just her, either.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She also took her singing very seriously.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha! I guess that's just how they've always been, huh?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Still, it's kinda strange...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They didn't know each other all that well back then, but they ended up producing this one SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Their feelings must've been just that strong.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But the way they meet, face their true feelings and make their dream come true does make for quite a story.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it does...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But things are just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They're about to take their feelings and set out into the world!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'll keep watching over them, so I hope you keep giving them all the support you can...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm counting on you, me!
